status: FROZEN prospective hypothesis. Historical MVP-B1 T2 results are HYPOTHESIS-DISCOVERY evidence only (same data selected the rule), not confirmation.
hypothesis: Publicly available monthly bank-only NII (months 1-2 of a quarter) improves forecasts of quarterly CONSOLIDATED NII relative to unconditional benchmarks.
target: consolidated net interest income, standalone quarter (quarterly publication CONSOLIDATED column; Q1 = YTD, Qn = YTD_n - YTD_(n-1)), IDR bn
forecast_formula: NII_cons_hat(q) = 1.5 x NII_BO2(q) + AdjNII(latest quarter with consolidated and bank-only NII available at origin)
rule_choice: IM1 (x1.5) = the simplest information-matched run-rate rule; chosen ex ante for BOTH banks (no bank-specific selection). IM4 is NOT the registered rule.

eligible_inputs.NII_BO2: bank-only YTD NII at month 2 minus bank-only YTD NII at previous quarter end (0 for Q1); previous quarter end from the quarterly publication INDIVIDUAL column
eligible_inputs.AdjNII: consolidated NII minus bank-only NII of the latest available quarter

forecast_origin: verified publication date of the quarter's month-2 monthly report (BBRI: IR posting date; BBCA: filename date prefix, or an archived listing date recorded at the time). Forecasts are computed and journaled ON the origin date (or the first working session after it) BEFORE the quarterly result is published.
point_in_time: only documents available at the origin; original (first-listed) vintages; no revisions

benchmarks.U1_last_quarter: consolidated NII of the latest available quarter
benchmarks.U4_AR1: OLS NII_t = a + b NII_(t-1) on all available history since 2018Q1, one-step forecast

evaluation_window: first quarter 2026Q4; only quarters whose forecast was journaled before the result was published
interim_review: at n = 8 per bank: KILL if MAE(rule) >= MAE of the best of U1/U2/U4
final_test: at n = 12 per bank: PASS if MAE(rule) <= 0.85 x MAE of EACH of U1, U2, U4 AND Holm-adjusted (3 comparisons) one-sided DM p <= 0.05 vs each
multiple_testing_note: two banks tested independently; a PASS is claimed per bank; Bonferroni x2 reported alongside
interpretation_limits: a PASS demonstrates forecasting accuracy only; it does not demonstrate that markets or analysts under-react (see MVP_B1_event_study_design.json); no trading or BUY implications
change_policy: frozen; any variant is a new registration
